Eliot Engel was a giant of New York politics and one of the greatest champions the Bronx has ever had in Congress. He served for more than three decades with unyielding dedication, fighting for his constituents and standing up for democracy around the world.

He was a trailblazer for the Bronx in Washington, and a fierce advocate for Kosovo and the Albanian community at a time when few others were paying attention. My deepest condolences go to his family and all who loved him.

Newly created Polymarket accounts bet on the Iran ceasefire minutes before Trump announced it and walked away with hundreds of thousands in profits.

Either God is on Polymarket or someone had inside information. I demanded the @CFTC investigate.

What kind of trader would make a massive trade at 6:49 a.m., 15 minutes before a market-moving presidential announcement with billions of dollars at stake and without a hedge?

The only plausible answer to that question is an insider trader. Any other alternative is a statistical impossibility.

Yesterday, I was proud to deliver $700,000 to Hostos Community College for their first library renovation in 36 years.

Hostos moves students from the bottom 20% to the top 20% at four times the national average. As far as I’m concerned, $700,000 for Hostos is not an expense; it’s an investment in the future of the Bronx, and the return on that investment is the realization of the American dream.

ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE WIN: Diesel-fueled transport refrigeration units (TRUs) have long polluted Hunts Point, adding to truck traffic on the Cross Bronx Expressway. We are replacing 20 TPUs with cleaner technology and cutting dangerous emissions. Bronx families deserve clean air.

Video
Wishing a happy Easter to all who celebrate. May this day bring you peace, hope, and time with those you love.
Wishing a blessed Good Friday to all who observe. May this sacred day be a time for reflection, renewal, and hope.

Chag Pesach Sameach to all my Jewish friends and constituents. 

Passover is a celebration of liberation, a timeless message that resonates as powerfully today as it did millennia ago. In the face of rising antisemitism, may this Passover renew our commitment to the safety and dignity of the Jewish people and to the enduring fight for freedom everywhere.

I was proud to join the @MTA and @NYC_DOT today in Hunts Point to announce real progress on cleaner air for the Bronx.

Hunts Point is one of the largest food distribution hubs in the country, but it has also been a major source of pollution for the surrounding communities. Nearly 1,000 diesel-powered refrigeration units at the market, combined with nonstop truck traffic, have subjected Bronx residents to some of the worst air quality in the city.

Oral arguments are underway at the Supreme Court in a case that could strip citizenship from children born on American soil.

The Constitution is unequivocal. The 14th Amendment guarantees birthright citizenship, and the Supreme Court has affirmed it for more than a century. President Donald Trump’s executive order terminating birthright citizenship blatantly violates the plain meaning of the Constitution and the Court’s own precedents.

Street closures are in effect on 184th St, Bathgate Ave, and Bassford Ave. Please avoid the area.

In commemoration of the tragic Happy Land Social Club fire in the Bronx, I introduced a resolution to designate March 25 as a day of remembrance. May we honor the 87 lives lost and recommit to advocating for safety, dignity, and justice for all communities.
